resume.name: Hiro Lim
resume.summary: Technology associate with transferable experience in Python, SQL, and ETL, seeking to deepen capability as a Data Engineer. Demonstrated ability to build reliable batch data pipelines using these tools, improving team turnaround by 22%. Skilled in modeling analytics-ready datasets and monitoring data quality while managing approximately 24 work items per month. Proven track record of collaborating with colleagues to present progress during technical reviews and documenting decisions for stakeholders. Experience includes creating reporting templates that reduced manual preparation time by 17% and investigating service requests with clear supporting evidence. Ready to apply foundational skills in Python, SQL, and ETL pipelines to support data engineering initiatives.
